info.title: Facturac bounded customer-create command
info.description: Normative Phase 5A design; no deployed endpoint or enablement approval. Read with phase-5a-customer-create-command-contract.md. Exactly one create capability.

parameters.name: workspacePublicId
parameters.description: Explicit credential-bound ULID; either case accepted, canonical lowercase. Foreign/nonexistent context has identical denial.

parameters.name: entityPublicId
parameters.description: Explicit credential-bound ULID; either case accepted, canonical lowercase. Foreign/nonexistent context has identical denial.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Homologation denied before customer/default/ledger lookup. Cannot override binding.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque case-sensitive HTTP field value after standard outer OWS removal. Whitespace-only invalid. Printable ASCII, comma literal, not a list. Reject detectable duplicate fields; infrastructure must preserve one field. Random UUID recommended, not required. Never log raw value.

post.summary: Create one customer or replay its original acknowledgement
post.description: Requires current machine identity, customers:create in BOTH credential and parent, explicit production context and current original owner/administrator sponsor with verified email and configured/confirmed MFA. Revalidated under PostgreSQL locks on creation AND replay.

IntegrationBearer.description: Existing hashed credentials. Bearer validity alone is insufficient. No wildcard, sessions, cookies or delegation.

name.description: NFC normalize, trim ASCII SP/HT/CR/LF edges, then require 1–255 Unicode code points and no C0/C1 controls. Preserve case and internal spaces. Whole body max 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

tax_identification_number.description: ASCII edge trim and uppercase; normalized [A-Z0-9]{9,32}; preserve leading zeroes. No punctuation removal or number coercion.

country_code.description: Omission defaults to AO. ASCII edge trim/uppercase. Null/empty invalid. Two-letter validation, no ISO registry claim.

x-request-boundary.duplicateJsonMembers: reject after decoding member names, before lossy conversion
x-request-boundary.normalization: x-normalized-schema is normative post-normalization validation, in addition to wire schema. See contract.

x-unsupported-methods.recognizedEnabledPath: IP quota, bearer, verified quotas and scope/context denial ordering before 405; no body validation/key reservation/domain lookup. HEAD suppresses every error body.

x-idempotency.canonicalJson: Typed normalized command/context/principal/defaults version, sorted object keys, deterministic UTF-8 escaping, no floats. Golden vectors required.
x-idempotency.precommitFailure: atomic rollback, authorized retry may claim
x-idempotency.uncertainCommit: retry same key/payload, never automatically execute again

x-quotas.window: native fixed 60 seconds; adjacent-window burst permitted

x-transaction.database: primary PostgreSQL 18; SQLite fast tests only; MySQL external command denied

x-error-order: Disabled -> IP quota -> media/size -> bearer -> verified quotas -> preliminary sponsor/scope/context -> method/path/query/correlation/key/body -> attempted audit -> locked authorization -> idempotency -> domain/result/audit. Earlier generic faults take precedence; no business lookup before context authorization.
